name: Tenkuu no Hanayome Erabi
source:
The hero is called to the residence of the absurdly rich millionaire Ludman where he is graced by the company of three beautiful bachelorettes. Inside, the owner of the astute mansion suddenly declares to him: 

"Over the course of three days, you may spend all the time you desire with these ladies. Should one of them spark your interest, it would be best to choose one of them to become your bride."

In order to continue on his quest, however, the hero was in search for the "Heavenly Shield". To be able to bring this item into his possession, he has to engage in this bridal game and marry one of them!

...There he suddenly was, prompted with the most important, grueling decision of his life.

――The time allotted for the game is three days.

The (nameable) protagonist, You, has to decide with whom of the three he'll spend precious time and who will be the ultimate subject of his final decision.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180809023649/http://www.inspire-doujin.com/dq5/dq5_index.html]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
勇者受邀来到富可敌国的大富豪鲁德曼的宅邸，与三名美丽的未婚女子相聚。进入豪华宅邸后，主人突然向他宣布：

“接下来的三天里，你可以随心所欲地与这些女士相处。如果其中有人令你心动，最好从她们之中选一人成为你的新娘。”

然而，为了继续冒险，勇者正在寻找“天空之盾”。想把这件物品拿到手，他就必须参加这场新娘游戏，并与其中一人结婚！

…于是，他突然面临人生中最重要、也最艰难的抉择。

——游戏规定的期限为三天。

主人公悠（姓名可自定义）必须决定要与三人中的谁共度宝贵时光，以及最终选择谁。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180809023649/http://www.inspire-doujin.com/dq5/dq5_index.html]官方网站[/url]]
